# Vendor Documentation

This folder contains vendor-supplied ISO 20022 documentation and templates for
this implementation.

Externally licensed source standards (for example, the ISO 20022 Message
Definition Report PDFs) are not bundled in this repository. Obtain them
directly from their licensed publisher and store them locally outside version
control, or check the relevant license before adding them here.

## Files

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [.gitkeep](.gitkeep) | Placeholder file so the folder remains tracked when content changes. |

## Usage

- Add new vendor documents with clear, versioned filenames when possible.
- Keep source files unchanged and add derived notes under [docs/internal/](../internal/).
- Remove obsolete vendor files when they are superseded.
